candidate_review.reason: Late-warning deployment and the operator-delay warranty boundary are explicit in the source, but the assistant and final user position already supply a partial-installation procedure, actual-crew exercise, city readiness ownership, and incident review.

The seed correctly asks about current shuttle staffing for residential access, but it does not ask who sustains recurring service after capital funding or how corridor protection shapes later service expectations. The conversation already says to price the shuttle, name the cost owner, and include the shuttle in the public plan.

Operational reassessment under night, surge, and deployment conditions is source-grounded, but the conversation already requires an exercise, operating procedure, readiness ownership, published deviations, and continued drainage review.

prospective_gate_review.reason: Neither protected post-grant operating horizon nor later land-use/service-expectation pressure was materially represented.

cross_variant_diagnosis.verbose_variant: Operationally failed but partially reached the residential service/funding area with unsupported political-capital and funding-stream extrapolation.
cross_variant_diagnosis.seed_variant: Operationally passed and stayed source-safe, but narrowed the service question to current shuttle staffing already covered in the conversation.

constitutional_review.problem: The provisional seed portfolio mapped operationalized coverage to non-active and blocked graph handoff. That lets the same probabilistic conversation frame prevent deterministic graph pressure from being inspected.
constitutional_review.required_correction: Coverage remains receipt and attention metadata but cannot gate whether a seed receives deterministic canonical recall. Every valid seed must remain graph-recall eligible; the fresh reasoner, not the coverage classifier, applies, rejects, or parks recalled lenses.

decision.next: Correct the architecture provider-free: deterministically recall a compact canonical direct and graph portfolio from every model-authored seed kind regardless of joint coverage. Preserve coverage as metadata, preserve all candidates, and require fresh-context apply/reject/park disposition later. Validate canonical identity, caps, graph provenance, and absence of semantic filtering locally before considering any consumer call.
